purpose: Make the World Relational Atlas the spatial interface over the repository's country, institution, economic, geopolitical, religious, theological, historical and project-canon records without duplicating their canonical data.
core_rule: The map is a router and renderer over canonical records. Geometry tells us where something is; canonical owners tell us what it is; typed edges tell us how it is connected; time tells us when a relation is valid; issue records tell us what is broken or contested; programmes propose interventions; tikkun records describe repair and closure.

spatial_model.country: polygon or multipolygon identified by ISO3 and linked to a canonical country record
spatial_model.territory_or_region: polygon/multipolygon with constitutional-status metadata and canonical parent relations
spatial_model.organization_or_institution: point when a meaningful public headquarters/location exists; otherwise non-spatial node attached to country/jurisdiction
spatial_model.religious_institution_or_sacred_site: point/area node with tradition, institution type, legal status, historical period and source
spatial_model.company_or_facility: point for public facility/site; company legal entity may be non-spatial or have several locations
spatial_model.port_airport_base_infrastructure: point or line with operator, owner, jurisdiction, capacity and source
spatial_model.trade_finance_security_research_migratio: edge between nodes; rendered as a line or arc when spatial display helps
spatial_model.issue_or_event: point/polygon/edge attachment depending on actual geography; never assign a whole country as the geometry of a localized event unless the issue genuinely operates nationally
spatial_model.religion_or_theology: demographic, institutional, historical, legal or comparative layer rather than a territorial bloc

show: global flows and high-value cross-border edges

zoom_semantics.status: future expansion; requires higher-resolution geometry and curated coordinates

religion_runtime.global_baseline: Pew 2020 composition; published 2025; diversity rankings added 2026
religion_runtime.display_rule: Always show observation year. Historical religious identity, current affiliation, irreligion, diversity, state law and project theology are different fields.

entanglement_runtime.rule: An entanglement is a sourced relationship problem, not a moral property of a country or faith.
entanglement_runtime.serious_harm_rule: Trafficking, slavery, civilian casualties, abuse and similar harms are never scores or collectibles. Exploration progress may reward evidence, mechanism clarity and repair analysis only.

three_epistemic_planes.observable: institutions, laws, memberships, transactions, budgets, trade, ownership, demographics, events and other externally sourceable facts
three_epistemic_planes.interpretive: North/West/East/South, Swamp, covenant, tikkun and analytical/comparative readings
three_epistemic_planes.project_canon: Tim Dooley, Potatoverse, spiritual-bank/karmic-ledger, Son/Door, North-of-North and related internal mythology
three_epistemic_planes.display_rule: Every map card and edge identifies its plane; mixed cards preserve field-level provenance.

interaction_model.trace_mode: Start at any node and recursively follow typed edges to answer who funds, owns, depends on, supplies, protects, regulates, influences, teaches, migrates, worships, restricts, supports or is affected by whom.
interaction_model.time_mode: Render only observations and relationships valid for the selected date/period; historical harms and memberships must not permanently stain current identity.

game_like_research_model.name: Atlas Exploration / Tikkun Mode
game_like_research_model.principle: Progress measures knowledge quality and repair clarity, not domination, ideological conformity or quantities of human suffering.
missions: Complete a country's religion/irreligion profile from dated sources
Trace one supply chain end to end
Trace a political-finance relationship to primary records
Map one historical slavery relation and its modern institutional afterlife without inherited-guilt logic
Map one contemporary trafficking mechanism using reputable actor-specific evidence
Trace one North Programme capability chain
Find an unverified Tim/project claim and source, downgrade or reject it
Take one Swamp-tagged mechanism from diagnosis to a concrete tikkun route

routing_examples.route: country -> dated composition/unaffiliated/diversity -> national legal/institutional context -> history/migration -> sources; project theology remains separate
United States -> political-finance -> distinct organization/PAC entities -> FEC/source records -> policy/candidate edges; do not encode AIPAC as a property of Jews, Israel or Americans

country/region -> documented pattern or case -> affected populations -> recruiters/exploiters/transit/financial/law-enforcement/institution nodes -> source/legal status -> prevention/protection/prosecution/repair
historical period -> legal/economic system -> routes/ports/state/company/person/institution nodes -> abolition/change -> documented afterlives; descendants do not inherit personal guilt
country/institution -> exact Tim statement/project record -> date/source/exactness -> symbolic interpretation -> separately evidenced real-world relation if one exists
